title.zh: 特征选择：过滤、包装、嵌入

description.en: Why select features, mutual information and chi-squared by hand, why filters miss interactions, what greedy wrappers cost in model fits, and how L1 regularisation selects while it trains.
description.zh: 为什么要选特征，手算互信息和卡方，过滤法为什么看不见交互，贪心包装法要花多少次模型拟合，以及 L1 正则如何边训练边选特征。

name.zh: 为什么选特征；各类方法
嵌入法与 L1 正则

description.en: Thinking mutual information adds up over features, so features useless alone are useless together
description.zh: 以为互信息对特征可加，单独没用的特征合起来也没用

description.en: Thinking greedy forward selection finds the best subset
description.zh: 以为贪心前向选择能找到最好的子集

description.en: Underestimating the cost of wrappers on many features
description.zh: 低估包装法在特征很多时的代价

description.en: Selecting features on all the data and then cross-validating (leakage)
description.zh: 先用全部数据选特征、再做交叉验证（泄漏）

title.en: Why select features, and the map of methods
title.zh: 为什么要选特征，以及方法地图

text.en: You have a table with $d$ attributes and a label. **Feature selection** chooses which of the $d$ attributes the model gets to see. Real data often has thousands to millions of low-level attributes (pixels, words, genes), and most are useless or redundant.
text.zh: 你有一张有 $d$ 个属性和一个标签的表。**特征选择**（feature selection）决定模型能看到 $d$ 个属性里的哪些。真实数据常有成千上万甚至上百万个低层属性（像素、单词、基因），其中大多数没用或者重复。

text.en: **Main goal:** better performance on the evaluation metric. **Side goals:** the features that survive tell you something about the problem (and can suggest further features); fewer features mean a smaller model and a faster answer.
text.zh: **主要目标：**在评估指标上表现更好。**附带目标：**留下来的特征本身说明了问题的一些东西（还能启发新的特征）；特征少意味着模型小、答案快。

text.en: Two questions sort every method. (1) *What does it look at?* A **univariate** method scores one feature at a time; a **multivariate** method scores subsets of features together. (2) *Does it use the classifier?* A **filter** ranks features independently of the classifier; a **wrapper** trains the classifier to assess features; an **embedded** method selects while the model is being trained.
text.zh: 两个问题可以把所有方法分类。(1) *它看什么？***单变量**（univariate）方法一次给一个特征打分；**多变量**（multivariate）方法给特征子集一起打分。(2) *它用不用分类器？***过滤法**（filter）不依赖分类器给特征排序；**包装法**（wrapper）训练分类器来评估特征；**嵌入法**（embedded）在训练模型的同时完成选择。

rows.en: each feature (or subset) by a statistic
rows.zh: 用统计量给单个特征（或子集）打分

rows.en: subsets, by the classifier's validation score
rows.zh: 子集，用分类器的验证分数

rows.en: features, as a by-product of training
rows.zh: 特征，作为训练的副产品

rows.en: yes, but trained far fewer times

title.zh: 它在流程里的位置

body.en: Our job as ML practitioners: inspect and clean the data, choose a model suited to the attributes, and choose attributes useful for that model. Feature selection is the third job, and it can be done before the model (filter), around it (wrapper) or inside it (embedded).
body.zh: 机器学习从业者的工作：检查清洗数据，选一个适合这些属性的模型，再选对这个模型有用的属性。特征选择是第三件事，可以在模型之前做（过滤），围绕模型做（包装），或在模型内部做（嵌入）。

title.zh: 什么样的单个特征是好特征

text.en: Look at two categorical features and a label $c$ (four instances):
text.zh: 看两个类别型特征和标签 $c$（四个实例）：

text.en: $x_1$ is good: knowing it tells you the label (A means Y, B means N). $x_2$ is useless: C and D each appear once with Y and once with N. A good single feature is **dependent** on the label: it can predict the label by itself. “Correlated” is a loose word here, because features can be categorical, not only numbers.
text.zh: $x_1$ 好：知道它就知道标签（A 对应 Y，B 对应 N）。$x_2$ 没用：C 和 D 各自一次配 Y、一次配 N。好的单个特征和标签**相关**（dependent）：自己就能预测标签。这里的“相关”是个宽泛的词，因为特征可以是类别型的，不只是数。

text.en: How to score it depends on the type of feature:
text.zh: 怎么打分，取决于特征的类型：

rows.en: class means far apart relative to the spread of each class
rows.zh: 两类均值离得远，相对于各类自己的散布

rows.en: how far the joint is from the product of the marginals
rows.zh: 联合分布离“边缘分布乘积”有多远

rows.en: between-class variance relative to within-class variance
rows.zh: 类间方差相对类内方差
相关系数（如 Pearson），即 CFS

rows.en: keep features with large $|r|$ with the target
rows.zh: 保留与目标 $|r|$ 大的特征

text.en: Here $\mu_\pm$ and $\sigma_\pm$ are the mean and standard deviation of the feature within the positive and negative class. All of these look at one feature at a time, so scoring all $d$ features costs time linear in $d$.
text.zh: 这里 $\mu_\pm$、$\sigma_\pm$ 是该特征在正类、负类内部的均值和标准差。它们都一次只看一个特征，所以给 $d$ 个特征全部打分的时间和 $d$ 成线性。

prompt.en: A feature has class means $\mu_+ = 5$, $\mu_- = 3$ and standard deviations $\sigma_+ = \sigma_- = 4$. What is its S2N?
prompt.zh: 一个特征的类均值 $\mu_+ = 5$、$\mu_- = 3$，标准差 $\sigma_+ = \sigma_- = 4$。它的 S2N 是多少？

feedback.en: You divided by one standard deviation (4) and got 2/4. The denominator is the *sum* $\sigma_+ + \sigma_-$.
feedback.zh: 你只除了一个标准差（4），得 2/4。分母是两个标准差之*和* $\sigma_+ + \sigma_-$。

feedback.en: That is the raw gap of the means; S2N divides it by the spread.
feedback.zh: 这是均值之差本身；S2N 还要除以散布。

explain.en: $|5 - 3| / (4 + 4) = 0.25$: the classes overlap heavily, so this feature is weak.

title.en: Mutual information: how dependent are Y and X?
title.zh: 互信息：Y 和 X 有多相关

text.en: The slides' tool for the categorical case. Start from what independence means: $P(Y, X) = P(Y)P(X)$, the joint probability is the product of the marginals. **Mutual information** measures how far the joint is from that product:
text.zh: 课件处理类别型特征用的工具。先从独立的定义出发：$P(Y, X) = P(Y)P(X)$，联合概率等于边缘概率的乘积。**互信息**（mutual information）度量联合分布偏离这个乘积有多远：

items.en: $I = 0$: $Y$ and $X$ are independent (the log is 0 in every cell). The feature says nothing about the label.
items.zh: $I = 0$：$Y$ 与 $X$ 独立（每个格子里的对数都是 0）。这个特征对标签什么也没说。

items.en: $I > 0$: they are dependent. The larger, the more knowing $X$ tells you about $Y$ (it is never negative).
items.zh: $I > 0$：二者相关。越大，知道 $X$ 对了解 $Y$ 的帮助越大（它永远不会是负的）。

items.en: Rule: **select the features with the highest $I(Y;X_i)$.**
items.zh: 规则：**选 $I(Y;X_i)$ 最高的那些特征。**

text.en: From data we plug in empirical frequencies. With $n$ training instances and $\delta(a, b) = 1$ if $a = b$ and 0 otherwise:
text.zh: 有数据时，代入经验频率。设有 $n$ 个训练实例，$\delta(a, b)$ 在 $a = b$ 时为 1，否则为 0：

blocks.tex: \hat P(y, x) = \tfrac{1}{n}\sum_{t=1}^{n}\delta(y, y_t)\,\delta(x, x_{t}) \qquad \hat P(y) = \tfrac{1}{n}\sum_{t}\delta(y, y_t) \qquad \hat P(x) = \tfrac{1}{n}\sum_t \delta(x, x_t)

text.en: These are just counts divided by $n$: the share of rows with $(Y, X) = (y, x)$, and the shares of rows with $Y = y$ and $X = x$. A cell with $\hat P(y, x) = 0$ contributes 0 (we define $0 \log 0 = 0$).
text.zh: 其实就是计数除以 $n$：$(Y, X) = (y, x)$ 的行占比、$Y = y$ 的行占比、$X = x$ 的行占比。$\hat P(y, x) = 0$ 的格子贡献 0（约定 $0 \log 0 = 0$）。

text.en: For continuous $Y, X_i$ the sums become integrals over the densities:
text.zh: 对连续的 $Y, X_i$，求和变成对密度的积分：

title.zh: 另一个名字

body.en: Mutual information is **information gain**, the quantity a decision tree maximises when it picks a split: $I(X;Y) = H(Y) - H(Y \mid X)$ (Lecture 5). The next page shows why, and why MI is an *average of pointwise values*.
body.zh: 互信息就是**信息增益**（information gain），决策树选分裂时最大化的量：$I(X;Y) = H(Y) - H(Y \mid X)$（第 5 讲）。下一页推出为什么，以及为什么互信息是一堆“逐点值”的*平均*。

title.en: Deeper: MI is the expected PMI, and equals information gain
title.zh: 深入：互信息是 PMI 的期望，也等于信息增益

say.en: Look at one cell $(x, y)$ only. **Pointwise mutual information** (PMI) is how much more often the two values occur together than they would if independent, on a log scale. Positive: they attract. Zero: independent. Negative: they repel.
say.zh: 只看一个格子 $(x, y)$。**逐点互信息**（pointwise mutual information, PMI）是这两个值同时出现的频率比“若独立应有的频率”高多少，取对数。正：相互吸引；零：独立；负：相互排斥。

say.en: Mutual information is each cell's PMI weighted by how likely the cell is: the **expected PMI**, $E_{P(x,y)}[\mathrm{pmi}]$. Common cells count more than rare ones.
say.zh: 互信息就是每个格子的 PMI 按该格出现的概率加权：**PMI 的期望** $E_{P(x,y)}[\mathrm{pmi}]$。常见的格子比罕见的格子权重大。

why.en: It is the KL divergence between $P(x, y)$ and $P(x)P(y)$, and KL divergence is never negative and is 0 only when the two are equal. That is why $I \ge 0$ and $I = 0$ exactly when independent.
why.zh: 它是 $P(x, y)$ 与 $P(x)P(y)$ 之间的 KL 散度，而 KL 散度永远不为负，只有两者相等时才为 0。所以 $I \ge 0$，且恰在独立时 $I = 0$。

say.en: Rewrite the ratio inside the log with the definition of conditional probability, $P(x, y) = P(y \mid x)P(x)$. The $P(x)$ cancels.
say.zh: 用条件概率的定义 $P(x, y) = P(y \mid x)P(x)$ 改写对数里的比值，$P(x)$ 约掉了。

lines.tex: I = \sum_{x,y} P(x, y)\log_2 P(y \mid x) \;-\; \sum_{x,y} P(x, y)\log_2 P(y)

say.en: Split the log of a ratio into a difference of two logs, and the sum into two sums.
say.zh: 把比值的对数拆成两个对数之差，求和也拆成两个。

say.en: In the second sum, summing the joint over $x$ gives the marginal $P(y)$. What is left is minus the entropy of $Y$.
say.zh: 第二个求和里，对 $x$ 把联合概率加起来得到边缘 $P(y)$，剩下的正是 $Y$ 的熵的相反数。

say.en: The first sum is minus the **conditional entropy**: the average uncertainty about $Y$ left once $X$ is known.
say.zh: 第一个求和是**条件熵**（conditional entropy）的相反数：知道 $X$ 以后，$Y$ 还剩的平均不确定性。

say.en: Put them together: uncertainty before knowing $X$ minus uncertainty after. This is exactly the **information gain** of splitting a decision tree on $X$ (parent entropy minus the weighted entropy of the children). So a decision tree's greedy split and a filter's ranking are the same computation.
say.zh: 合起来：知道 $X$ 之前的不确定性减去之后的。这正是按 $X$ 分裂决策树的**信息增益**（父节点熵减去子节点熵的加权和）。所以决策树的贪心分裂和过滤法的排序，是同一个计算。

say.en: The formula is symmetric in $X$ and $Y$, so the same steps give this version. Mutual information is symmetric.
say.zh: 公式对 $X$ 和 $Y$ 对称，同样的步骤给出这个版本。互信息是对称的。

intro.en: Why the formula looks the way it does, and the link to the decision-tree lesson.
intro.zh: 公式为什么长这样，以及它和决策树那一课的联系。

title.en: Worked: the deck's example, I(Y; X₂) in bits
title.zh: 算例：课件的例子，I(Y; X₂)（以比特计）

say.en: The eight rows have four of each label. These are the marginals of $Y$.
say.zh: 八行里每个标签各四行，这是 $Y$ 的边缘分布。

say.en: Count how often each value of $X_2$ appears: value 1 three times, value 2 twice, value 3 three times.
say.zh: 数 $X_2$ 每个取值出现的次数：1 出现 3 次，2 出现 2 次，3 出现 3 次。

say.en: Count the joint cells, first those with $Y = -1$.
say.zh: 数联合格子，先数 $Y = -1$ 的。

say.en: Then $Y = +1$. The cell $(+1, 2)$ never occurs, so it will contribute nothing.
say.zh: 再数 $Y = +1$ 的。格子 $(+1, 2)$ 从未出现，所以它不贡献任何东西。

say.en: The ratio inside the log for the cell $(+1, 1)$: joint $2/8$ over the product of marginals $(4/8)(3/8)$. Above 1 means the pair occurs more often than independence predicts.
say.zh: 格子 $(+1, 1)$ 对数里的比值：联合 $2/8$ 除以边缘乘积 $(4/8)(3/8)$。大于 1 表示这一对出现得比独立时更多。

say.en: Cell $(-1, 1)$: ratio $2/3 < 1$, so the term is negative (this pair is rarer than chance).
say.zh: 格子 $(-1, 1)$：比值 $2/3 < 1$，所以这一项为负（这一对比随机时更少见）。

say.en: Cell $(-1, 2)$: ratio 2, a whole bit above chance, weighted by $2/8$.
say.zh: 格子 $(-1, 2)$：比值 2，比随机多一个比特，权重 $2/8$。

say.en: Cell $(-1, 3)$: the same as cell $(-1, 1)$.
Cell $(+1, 1)$: with the ratio $4/3$ from above.
Probability 0 contributes 0 by convention.
say.zh: 概率为 0 的格子按约定贡献 0。

say.en: Cell $(+1, 3)$: the same as cell $(+1, 1)$.
Add the five non-zero terms. $X_2$ carries about 0.31 bits of the 1 bit of uncertainty in $Y$ (the entropy of a fair coin).
say.zh: 把五个非零项加起来。$Y$ 本身有 1 比特的不确定性（公平硬币的熵），$X_2$ 带走了其中约 0.31 比特。

outro.en: Use $\log_2$ on the exam unless told otherwise; with a calculator, $\log_2 a = \ln a / \ln 2$.
outro.zh: 考试里除非另说，都用 $\log_2$；计算器上 $\log_2 a = \ln a / \ln 2$。

prompt.en: The ratio inside the log for the cell $(+1, 1)$: joint over product of marginals.
prompt.zh: 格子 $(+1, 1)$ 对数里的比值：联合概率除以边缘概率的乘积。

title.en: Ranking all three features, and chi-squared
title.zh: 三个特征排个序，再看卡方

text.en: The same table has $X_1$ and $X_3$ too. Doing the same sum for each:
text.zh: 同一张表里还有 $X_1$ 和 $X_3$。同样做一遍求和：

rows.en: value 1 and 2 split both classes almost evenly
rows.zh: 取值 1、2 在两个类里几乎各占一半

rows.en: value 2 occurs only with $-1$, but 1 and 3 are mixed
rows.zh: 取值 2 只出现在 $-1$，但 1 和 3 混在一起

rows.en: value 1 occurs only with $-1$ (3 rows); value 2 is mostly $+1$
rows.zh: 取值 1 只出现在 $-1$（3 行）；取值 2 大多是 $+1$

text.en: Filter: rank $X_3 > X_2 > X_1$ and keep the top $k$. The number $k$ is not given by the filter: it is chosen, often by cross-validation.
text.zh: 过滤：排序为 $X_3 > X_2 > X_1$，保留前 $k$ 个。$k$ 不由过滤法给出，需要另外选，常用交叉验证。

text.en: Chi-squared
text.zh: 卡方

text.en: The **chi-squared test** asks the same question as MI in different units: is the contingency table what independence would produce? For each cell compare the observed count $O$ with the count $E = (\text{row total})(\text{column total})/n$ expected under independence:
text.zh: **卡方检验**（chi-squared）问的和互信息是同一个问题，只是单位不同：列联表是不是独立时该有的样子？每个格子拿观测计数 $O$ 与独立时的期望计数 $E = (\text{行合计})(\text{列合计})/n$ 比较：

text.en: For $X_2$: under independence, value 1 should appear 1.5 times with each label, value 2 once, value 3 1.5 times. Observed $(1, 2, 1)$ for $-1$ and $(2, 0, 2)$ for $+1$, so $\chi^2 = 4 \cdot \frac{0.5^2}{1.5} + 2\cdot\frac{1^2}{1} = 2.67$. It has $(3-1)(2-1) = 2$ degrees of freedom; the 5% critical value is 5.99, so with only 8 rows none of the three features is statistically significant.
text.zh: 以 $X_2$ 为例：独立时，取值 1 应在每个标签下各出现 1.5 次，取值 2 各 1 次，取值 3 各 1.5 次。观测到 $-1$ 为 $(1, 2, 1)$，$+1$ 为 $(2, 0, 2)$，于是 $\chi^2 = 4 \cdot \frac{0.5^2}{1.5} + 2\cdot\frac{1^2}{1} = 2.67$。自由度 $(3-1)(2-1) = 2$，5% 临界值是 5.99，所以只有 8 行时三个特征都不显著。

title.zh: 卡方和互信息是一回事的两面

body.en: For large $n$, $\chi^2 \approx G = 2n \ln 2 \cdot I$ (with $I$ in bits): the chi-squared statistic is MI, scaled by the sample size. Here $G = 3.45$ against $\chi^2 = 2.67$ (small $n$, so only roughly equal). Both rank the three features the same way.
body.zh: 当 $n$ 较大时，$\chi^2 \approx G = 2n \ln 2 \cdot I$（$I$ 以比特计）：卡方统计量就是按样本量放大的互信息。这里 $G = 3.45$，$\chi^2 = 2.67$（$n$ 小，只是大致相等）。两者对三个特征排出同样的顺序。

title.zh: 取值很多的特征会作弊

body.en: A feature with a different value on every row (an ID) has estimated $\hat I = H(Y) = 1$ bit, the maximum, though it predicts nothing new. Empirical MI favours features with many values; decision trees correct this with the **gain ratio** (divide by the feature's own entropy).
body.zh: 每行取值都不同的特征（比如 ID）估计出的 $\hat I = H(Y) = 1$ 比特，是最大值，可它对新数据毫无预测力。经验互信息偏爱取值多的特征；决策树用**增益率**（gain ratio，除以特征自身的熵）来修正。

title.en: Deeper: why a filter misses features that only work together
title.zh: 深入：为什么过滤法会漏掉“合起来才有用”的特征

say.en: The label is 1 when exactly one of the two features is 1 (**XOR**, exclusive or). Take the four combinations $(x_1, x_2)$ as four equally likely rows.
say.zh: 两个特征恰有一个为 1 时标签为 1（**异或**，XOR）。把四种组合 $(x_1, x_2)$ 当作四个等可能的行。

say.en: Look at $x_1$ alone. Whether $x_1$ is 0 or 1, half the rows have label 1: the label is 1 when $x_2 = 1$, and $x_2$ is hidden.
say.zh: 只看 $x_1$。不管 $x_1$ 是 0 还是 1，都有一半的行标签为 1：$x_2 = 1$ 时标签为 1，而 $x_2$ 被藏起来了。

say.en: The conditional equals the marginal, so $Y$ and $X_1$ are independent and the mutual information is exactly 0.
say.zh: 条件概率等于边缘概率，所以 $Y$ 与 $X_1$ 独立，互信息恰好为 0。

say.en: The same argument, by symmetry, for $x_2$. A univariate filter ranks both features at the bottom and throws them away.
say.zh: 对 $x_2$ 同样的论证（由对称性）。单变量过滤法把两个特征都排在最后，扔掉。

say.en: Now treat the pair as one variable: knowing both determines $y$ completely, so the conditional entropy is 0 and the pair carries the full bit.
say.zh: 现在把这一对当作一个变量：两个都知道时 $y$ 完全确定，条件熵为 0，这一对带有全部的 1 比特。

intro.zh: 课件第 20 页说单变量选择可能失败。下面是必然失败的最小例子：

outro.en: A filter judges each feature alone, so it cannot see **interactions**. It also cannot see **redundancy**: two copies of the same good feature both score high, and both are kept. Wrappers, which score the subset, can see both.
outro.zh: 过滤法一次只评判一个特征，所以看不见**交互**（interaction）；它也看不见**冗余**（redundancy）：同一个好特征的两份拷贝都得高分，都被保留。给子集打分的包装法两者都看得见。

caption.en: Project onto $x_1$ alone (drop the vertical axis): at $x_1 = 0$ there is one point of each colour, and the same at $x_1 = 1$. Nothing separates the classes on one axis; in the plane, the two diagonals do.
caption.zh: 投影到 $x_1$ 一条轴（去掉竖轴）：$x_1 = 0$ 处两种颜色各一个点，$x_1 = 1$ 处也一样。单看一条轴分不开两类；在平面里，两条对角线就能分开。

text.en: The same shape returns in the perceptron lesson: a linear model on the two features cannot separate XOR either. So an L1-regularised *linear* model would also drop both features. Selection and model must fit each other.
text.zh: 同样的图形会在感知机那一课再出现：对这两个特征做线性模型同样分不开 XOR。所以 L1 正则的*线性*模型也会把两个特征都丢掉。选择方法和模型要互相配合。

title.en: Wrappers: the search space is a lattice of 2^d subsets
title.zh: 包装法：搜索空间是 2^d 个子集组成的格

text.en: A **wrapper** treats the classifier as a black box and asks: *which subset of features gives the best validation performance?* Each candidate subset costs one **train-and-evaluate cycle**: train on the training set, score on the validation set.
text.zh: **包装法**（wrapper）把分类器当作黑盒，问：*哪个特征子集让验证集上的表现最好？* 每个候选子集花一次**训练—评估循环**：在训练集上训练，在验证集上打分。

alt.zh: 四个特征的 16 个子集组成的格，用 4 位串表示（1 = 选中），按大小 0 到 4 排成五行，各有 1、4、6、4、1 个子集。蓝色路径从 0000 往下每次加一个特征走到 1111；橙色路径从 1111 每次去掉一个特征走到 0000。

caption.en: Each box is a subset (position = feature, 1 = chosen). Blue: forward selection. Orange: backward elimination.
caption.zh: 每个框是一个子集（位置 = 特征，1 = 选中）。蓝：前向选择。橙：后向消除。

text.en: How many boxes? Each feature is in or out, so $2^d$. Counting by size gives the same thing: $\binom{d}{0} + \binom{d}{1} + \dots + \binom{d}{d} = (1 + 1)^d = 2^d$ (the binomial theorem with both terms equal to 1).
text.zh: 有多少个框？每个特征要么在要么不在，所以是 $2^d$。按大小数也得同一个结果：$\binom{d}{0} + \binom{d}{1} + \dots + \binom{d}{d} = (1 + 1)^d = 2^d$（二项式定理，两项都取 1）。

text.en: **Exhaustive search** tries every box and is guaranteed to find the best subset *for this learner on this validation set*. Its cost is what kills it. Say a fast learner (a decision tree on ~50 000 rows) takes 10 seconds per cycle:
text.zh: **穷举搜索**每个框都试一遍，保证找到*这个学习器在这个验证集上*最好的子集。它的代价让它没法用。假设一个很快的学习器（约 5 万行上的决策树）每次循环 10 秒：

text.en: Exhaustive search is practical only for very few features. The wrappers in practice are **greedy** searches that walk one path through the lattice.
text.zh: 穷举只对很少的特征可行。实际使用的包装法是**贪心**搜索：在格里只走一条路径。

title.zh: 前向选择与后向消除

text.en: Forward selection (wrapper)
text.zh: 前向选择（包装法）

items.en: Start from the empty set $S = \{\}$.
items.zh: 从空集 $S = \{\}$ 开始。

items.en: For each feature not in $S$, train the model on $S \cup \{j\}$ and score it on the validation set.
items.zh: 对每个不在 $S$ 里的特征 $j$，在 $S \cup \{j\}$ 上训练并在验证集上打分。

items.en: Add the best one to $S$.
items.zh: 把最好的那个加入 $S$。

items.en: Repeat until nothing improves or $S$ is as big as wanted; keep the best subset seen.
items.zh: 重复，直到没有改进或者 $S$ 够大；保留见过的最好子集。

text.en: **Pros:** performs best when the optimal subset is **small**. **Cons:** still $O(d^2)$ cycles; may converge to a sub-optimal (even bad) solution, since each choice is never undone; not feasible on large data sets.
text.zh: **优点：**最优子集**很小**时效果最好。**缺点：**仍要 $O(d^2)$ 次循环；每个选择不会撤销，可能收敛到次优（甚至很差）的解；大数据集上不可行。

text.en: Backward elimination (wrapper)
text.zh: 后向消除（包装法）

text.en: The mirror image: start from all $d$ features; at each step train $|S|$ models, each with one feature removed, and drop the feature whose removal hurts least. **Pros:** removes most irrelevant attributes at the start; best when the optimal subset is **large**. **Cons:** the same: running time, sub-optimal solutions, not feasible on large data (and each early model has many features, so it is slower).
text.zh: 镜像做法：从全部 $d$ 个特征开始；每一步训练 $|S|$ 个模型，每个去掉一个特征，丢掉去掉后伤害最小的那个。**优点：**一开始就去掉大部分无关属性；最优子集**较大**时最好。**缺点：**一样：运行时间、次优解、大数据集不可行（而且早期的模型特征很多，更慢）。

text.en: **Example:** a decision tree grown with entropy is a forward selection in disguise: at each node it picks the feature that reduces entropy most, and never goes back.
text.zh: **例子：**按熵生长的决策树就是伪装的前向选择：每个节点选熵下降最多的特征，从不回头。

title.zh: 贪心前向选择碰上 XOR

body.en: With the XOR pair of the last page and a weak third feature $x_3$, forward selection adds $x_3$ first. Then $x_1$ alone does not improve the score, nor does $x_2$ alone, so it stops. Only a search that tries $\{x_1, x_2\}$ together, such as backward elimination from the full set, finds the pair.
body.zh: 碰上前面那对 XOR 特征和一个弱特征 $x_3$，前向选择先加 $x_3$。接着单独加 $x_1$ 不提升分数，单独加 $x_2$ 也不提升，于是停下。只有一次试一对 $\{x_1, x_2\}$ 的搜索，比如从全集开始的后向消除，才找得到这一对。

title.en: Deeper: how many model fits does forward selection need?
title.zh: 深入：前向选择要拟合多少个模型？

say.en: Step 1 tries each of the $d$ features alone: $d$ fits. Step 2 tries each of the $d - 1$ remaining features added to the chosen one: $d - 1$ fits. And so on, until the last feature is added: 1 fit.
say.zh: 第 1 步把 $d$ 个特征各单独试一遍：$d$ 次拟合。第 2 步在已选的上面各加剩下的 $d - 1$ 个特征之一：$d - 1$ 次。依此类推，直到最后一个特征加入：1 次。

say.en: The same sum written backwards.
say.zh: 同一个和，倒过来写。

say.en: Add the two versions term by term: each column adds up to $d + 1$ and there are $d$ columns (Gauss's trick).
say.zh: 把两个版本逐项相加：每一列的和都是 $d + 1$，共有 $d$ 列（高斯的办法）。

say.en: Divide by 2. The cost grows like $d^2$, polynomial, against $2^d$ for the exhaustive search. Backward elimination has the same count: $d$ models with one feature removed, then $d - 1$, and so on.
say.zh: 除以 2。代价约按 $d^2$ 增长，是多项式，穷举则是 $2^d$。后向消除的次数相同：先 $d$ 个去掉一个特征的模型，再 $d - 1$ 个，依此类推。

say.en: The slides' four-feature picture: 10 cycles. For small $d$ the saving is small, and it explodes as $d$ grows.
say.zh: 课件里四个特征的图：10 次循环。$d$ 小时省得不多，$d$ 一大就省得惊人。

say.en: 5050 fits is a few hours at 10 s each; $2^{100}$ is beyond the age of the universe.
say.zh: 5050 次拟合，按每次 10 秒算也就几个小时；$2^{100}$ 超过宇宙的年龄。

say.en: If you only want the best $k$ features, stop after $k$ steps; $S_k$ is the number of fits. For $d = 100$, $k = 5$: $500 - 10 = 490$ fits. Multiply any of these by the number of folds if every candidate is scored by $m$-fold cross-validation.
say.zh: 如果只要最好的 $k$ 个特征，$k$ 步后就停；$S_k$ 是拟合次数。$d = 100$、$k = 5$：$500 - 10 = 490$ 次拟合。如果每个候选用 $m$ 折交叉验证打分，以上每个数还要乘 $m$。

intro.en: The lecture's claim, $d + (d-1) + \dots + 1 = d(d+1)/2$ cycles, derived.
intro.zh: 课件的结论 $d + (d-1) + \dots + 1 = d(d+1)/2$ 次循环，现在推出来。

title.en: Assessing a subset, and the price of searching
title.zh: 怎样评估一个子集，以及搜索的代价

text.en: **Assessment.** Split the data into training, validation and test sets. For each feature subset, train on the training set; pick the subset that does best on the **validation** set; report the performance of that one on the **test** set. (With little data, replace the validation set by cross-validation.) Never judge a subset on the test set.
text.zh: **评估。**把数据分成训练集、验证集和测试集。对每个特征子集，在训练集上训练；选在**验证集**上最好的子集；用**测试集**报告它的表现。（数据少时，用交叉验证代替验证集。）绝不要用测试集来评判子集。

text.en: **The price of searching.** The more subsets you compare on the same validation set, the more likely the winner is lucky: its validation error is flattering. A bound on the real (generalisation) error captures this:
text.zh: **搜索的代价。**在同一个验证集上比较的子集越多，赢家越可能只是运气好：它的验证误差偏乐观。真实（泛化）误差的一个界刻画了这点：

text.en: $E_{\text{gen}}$ is the real (generalisation) error, $E_{\text{val}}$ the validation error, $n_{\text{val}}$ the number of validation examples and $C$ the complexity of the search, roughly $\log(\text{number of subsets compared})$ (up to constants).
text.zh: $E_{\text{gen}}$ 是真实（泛化）误差，$E_{\text{val}}$ 是验证误差，$n_{\text{val}}$ 是验证样本数，$C$ 是搜索的复杂度，大致是 $\log(\text{比较过的子集数})$（相差一个常数）。

rows.zh: 所有大小为 $k$ 的子集

text.en: So searching all subsets costs a penalty that grows linearly with $d$, while restricting to small subsets of size $k$ grows only like $k \log d$. Intuition: with few validation examples and many candidates, something will look good by chance. More validation data ($n_{\text{val}}$ up) shrinks the penalty.
text.zh: 所以搜索全部子集，惩罚随 $d$ 线性增长；只限定在大小为 $k$ 的小子集，则只按 $k \log d$ 增长。直觉：验证样本少、候选多，总有一个碰巧看起来好。验证数据多（$n_{\text{val}}$ 增大）则惩罚变小。

prompt.en: You select 10 features out of 5 000 genes using all 100 samples, **then** run 10-fold cross-validation on the 10 chosen features and get 95% accuracy. What is wrong?
prompt.zh: 你用全部 100 个样本从 5000 个基因里选出 10 个，**然后**对这 10 个特征做 10 折交叉验证，得到 95% 的准确率。问题在哪？

label.en: Nothing: cross-validation always gives an honest estimate
label.zh: 没问题：交叉验证总能给出诚实的估计

feedback.en: Only if every step that looks at labels happens *inside* each fold. Here the selection already saw the labels of every fold's validation part.
feedback.zh: 只有所有看过标签的步骤都发生在每一折*内部*才是这样。这里选择时已经看过每一折验证部分的标签了。

label.en: Selection saw the labels of the validation folds, so the 95% is optimistic; selection must be repeated inside each training fold
label.zh: 选择时已经看过验证折的标签，所以 95% 偏乐观；选择必须在每个训练折内部重做

label.en: 10 features are too few for 100 samples
label.zh: 100 个样本配 10 个特征太少了

feedback.en: The number of features is not the problem; the leak is. With 5 000 candidates, some features correlate with the labels by chance, and picking them with all the labels makes any validation score look good.
feedback.zh: 问题不在特征数，而在泄漏。5000 个候选里总有些特征碰巧与标签相关，用全部标签去挑它们，任何验证分数都会好看。

explain.en: This is the classic selection-bias mistake (Hastie, Tibshirani & Friedman, *ESL* §7.10.2): feature selection is part of the model, so it belongs inside the cross-validation loop.
explain.zh: 这是经典的选择偏差错误（Hastie、Tibshirani、Friedman，《ESL》§7.10.2）：特征选择是模型的一部分，所以要放在交叉验证的循环里面。

title.zh: 嵌入法：边训练边选

text.en: An **embedded** method completes the selection inside the construction of the learning algorithm. Like a wrapper it measures how *useful* features are for predicting $Y$ and finishes with cross-validation, but its search is **guided by what the classifier knows**, so it does not train a new classifier for every candidate. It is similar to a wrapper and cheaper.
text.zh: **嵌入法**（embedded）把选择放进学习算法的构造里完成。和包装法一样，它衡量特征对预测 $Y$ 有多*有用*，最后用交叉验证；但它的搜索**由分类器已有的知识引导**，所以不必为每个候选训练新的分类器。它类似包装法，但便宜。

rows.en: trains a new classifier for every candidate: 10 cycles
rows.zh: 每个候选训练一个新分类器：10 次

rows.en: uses the classifier to judge candidates, trains only after adding one: 4 cycles
rows.zh: 用分类器判断候选，加入一个才训练：4 次

rows.en: trains a new classifier for every candidate removal: 10 cycles
rows.zh: 每个候选的去除都训练一个新分类器：10 次

rows.en: uses the classifier to judge, trains only after removing one: 4 cycles
rows.zh: 用分类器判断，去掉一个才训练：4 次

text.en: Example: recursive feature elimination (RFE) with an SVM
text.zh: 例子：用 SVM 做递归特征消除（RFE）

text.en: Hard-margin SVM on $(\mathbf{x}_i, y_i)$, $y_i \in \{-1, +1\}$: minimise $\tfrac12\lVert\boldsymbol\theta\rVert^2 = \tfrac12\sum_{j=1}^{d}\theta_j^2$ subject to $y_i(\boldsymbol\theta\cdot\mathbf{x}_i) \ge 1$. The weight $\theta_j$ says how much the model leans on feature $j$.
text.zh: 硬间隔 SVM，数据 $(\mathbf{x}_i, y_i)$，$y_i \in \{-1, +1\}$：在约束 $y_i(\boldsymbol\theta\cdot\mathbf{x}_i) \ge 1$ 下最小化 $\tfrac12\lVert\boldsymbol\theta\rVert^2 = \tfrac12\sum_{j=1}^{d}\theta_j^2$。权重 $\theta_j$ 说明模型有多依赖特征 $j$。

items.en: Start with all features, $S = \{1, \dots, d\}$.
items.zh: 从全部特征 $S = \{1, \dots, d\}$ 开始。

items.en: Train an SVM $\boldsymbol\theta$ on the features in $S$.
items.zh: 在 $S$ 里的特征上训练 SVM $\boldsymbol\theta$。

items.en: Find the feature $j \in S$ with the smallest $\theta_j^2$.
items.zh: 找出 $S$ 里 $\theta_j^2$ 最小的特征 $j$。

items.en: Remove it: $S = S - \{j\}$.
Check that the validation error is not worse; if not, go back to step 2.
items.zh: 检查验证误差没有变差；没有的话，回到第 2 步。

text.en: One training run per step ($d$ in total), because the weights themselves rank the features. The **wrapper** version of RFE does not use $\theta_j^2$: it trains and evaluates one model per candidate removal and keeps the removal whose model is best, which costs $d(d+1)/2$ runs.
text.zh: 每步训练一次（共 $d$ 次），因为权重本身就给特征排了序。RFE 的**包装法**版本不用 $\theta_j^2$：对每个候选的去除各训练、评估一个模型，保留模型最好的那个去除，要 $d(d+1)/2$ 次训练。

title.en: Weights are only comparable on comparable scales
title.zh: 权重只有在尺度可比时才可比

body.en: Ranking features by $\theta_j^2$ assumes the features have comparable scales; standardise them first, or a feature measured in tiny units will get a huge weight for no reason.
body.zh: 按 $\theta_j^2$ 给特征排序，默认各特征尺度可比；要先标准化，否则用很小单位度量的特征会无缘无故得到很大的权重。

title.en: L0 and L1 regularisation: make the model drop features itself
title.zh: L0 与 L1 正则：让模型自己丢特征

text.en: A different strategy: instead of searching over subsets, **change the objective** so that the training itself drives unneeded weights to exactly zero. A weight $\theta_j = 0$ means feature $j$ is not used.
text.zh: 另一种策略：不在子集上搜索，而是**改变目标函数**，让训练本身把不需要的权重推到恰好为零。权重 $\theta_j = 0$ 就表示没用特征 $j$。

text.en: The direct way: minimise the number of non-zero weights, the **L0 norm** (with $\delta$ the Kronecker delta, 1 if its two arguments are equal, else 0):
text.zh: 最直接的做法：最小化非零权重的个数，即 **L0 范数**（$\delta$ 是 Kronecker delta，两个参数相等为 1，否则为 0）：

text.en: Each term is 1 if $\theta_j \ne 0$ and 0 if $\theta_j = 0$. But this function is **not continuous** (it jumps at 0), so it is not convex and gradients tell us nothing. Amaldi and Kann (1998) showed that this feature selection problem is combinatorially hard: it may require going through all $2^d$ subsets.
text.zh: 每一项在 $\theta_j \ne 0$ 时为 1，在 $\theta_j = 0$ 时为 0。但这个函数**不连续**（在 0 处跳变），所以不是凸的，梯度也说明不了什么。Amaldi 和 Kann（1998）证明这个特征选择问题是组合困难的：可能要把 $2^d$ 个子集都过一遍。

text.en: The fix: replace the jump by its closest convex relative, the **L1 norm** (taxicab or Manhattan norm):
text.zh: 补救办法：用最接近它的凸函数替代那个跳变，即 **L1 范数**（出租车范数或曼哈顿范数）：

alt.en: Left: the L0 term, equal to 1 everywhere except exactly 0 where it drops to 0. Right: the L1 term |θ|, a V with its corner at 0.
alt.zh: 左：L0 项，除了恰好在 0 处降为 0，其他地方都等于 1。右：L1 项 |θ|，是在 0 处有尖角的 V 形。

text.en: It is convex, so it can be minimised reliably, and the solution $\boldsymbol\theta^*$ usually has **few non-zero entries**. In practice it is added to the training loss with a weight $\lambda$ (as in the LASSO): $\text{loss}(\boldsymbol\theta) + \lambda\sum_j|\theta_j|$. The next page shows why the V's corner produces exact zeros.
text.zh: 它是凸的，所以能可靠地最小化，解 $\boldsymbol\theta^*$ 通常**只有很少的非零项**。实际中它按权重 $\lambda$ 加到训练损失上（如 LASSO）：$\text{loss}(\boldsymbol\theta) + \lambda\sum_j|\theta_j|$。下一页说明为什么 V 的尖角会产生恰好为零的权重。

title.en: Deeper: why L1 gives exact zeros and L2 does not
title.zh: 深入：为什么 L1 给出恰好的零而 L2 不会

say.en: One weight in its simplest form. $a$ is the value the weight would take with no penalty (the fit pulls $\theta$ towards $a$); $\lambda > 0$ is the penalty strength (it pulls $\theta$ towards 0). Take $a > 0$.
say.zh: 一个权重的最简形式。$a$ 是没有惩罚时权重的取值（拟合项把 $\theta$ 拉向 $a$）；$\lambda > 0$ 是惩罚强度（把 $\theta$ 拉向 0）。取 $a > 0$。

say.en: On the right of 0, $|\theta| = \theta$ and the function is smooth. Set the derivative to zero. This is a valid answer only if $a - \lambda > 0$, that is $a > \lambda$.
say.zh: 在 0 的右边，$|\theta| = \theta$，函数光滑。令导数为 0。只有 $a - \lambda > 0$，即 $a > \lambda$ 时，这才是有效的解。

say.en: If $a \le \lambda$ the slope is non-negative everywhere on the right of 0, so $f$ only increases there. The penalty's slope $\lambda$ beats the fit's pull $a$.
say.zh: 若 $a \le \lambda$，在 0 的右边斜率处处不为负，所以 $f$ 在那里只会上升。惩罚的斜率 $\lambda$ 压过了拟合的拉力 $a$。

say.en: On the left of 0, $a > 0$ and the slope is negative: $f$ decreases towards 0. So the minimum cannot lie on the left.
say.zh: 在 0 的左边，$a > 0$，斜率为负：$f$ 向 0 递减。所以最小值不会在左边。

say.en: Together (and by symmetry for $a < 0$): **soft thresholding**. Shrink $a$ towards 0 by $\lambda$, and if that crosses 0, stop *at* 0. Whenever $|a| \le \lambda$, the weight is exactly zero: the V's corner traps it.
say.zh: 合起来（$a < 0$ 时由对称性）：**软阈值**（soft thresholding）。把 $a$ 向 0 收缩 $\lambda$，如果越过 0，就停*在* 0。只要 $|a| \le \lambda$，权重就恰好为零：V 的尖角把它困住了。

say.en: Compare the squared penalty. Its slope $2\lambda\theta$ shrinks to 0 as $\theta \to 0$, so it never overpowers the fit near 0: it shrinks every weight by a factor but never to exactly 0.
say.zh: 对比平方惩罚。它的斜率 $2\lambda\theta$ 在 $\theta \to 0$ 时也趋于 0，所以在 0 附近压不过拟合项：它把每个权重按比例缩小，但绝不会缩到恰好为 0。

say.en: A weak feature (pull 0.8, penalty 1): L1 deletes it; L2 keeps a small weight. With $a = 3$: L1 gives 2, L2 gives 1. This is why L1 selects features and L2 (ridge) only shrinks them.
say.zh: 一个弱特征（拉力 0.8，惩罚 1）：L1 把它删掉；L2 保留一个小权重。$a = 3$ 时：L1 给 2，L2 给 1。这就是 L1 能选特征而 L2（岭）只能收缩的原因。

intro.en: The slides say the L1 solution “usually has few non-zero entries”. One weight, one derivative, shows why.
intro.zh: 课件只说 L1 的解“通常只有很少的非零项”。一个权重、一个导数，就能看出为什么。

outro.en: In many dimensions the same picture is the L1 ball, a diamond whose corners sit on the axes: the loss contours usually first touch it at a corner, where some coordinates are 0.
outro.zh: 在高维里，同样的图像就是 L1 球：一个角落在坐标轴上的菱形，损失等高线通常先碰到它的角，那里一些坐标为 0。

title.en: Filter, wrapper, embedded: choosing between them
title.zh: 过滤、包装、嵌入：怎么选

rows.zh: 特征（或子集）与 $Y$ 的相关性
子集对分类器的有用程度

rows.en: subset usefulness, from the model itself
rows.zh: 子集的有用程度，来自模型本身
给特征排序（排名，或嵌套子集）

rows.en: search the space of subsets; a new classifier for each candidate
rows.zh: 在子集空间里搜索；每个候选一个新分类器

rows.en: guided by the classifier; no retraining per candidate
rows.zh: 由分类器引导；每个候选不必重训
无直接评估；可能用交叉验证选 $k$

rows.en: yes, for the subsets it tries
as far as the model can use them
information gain / MI, chi-square, correlation, S2N, ANOVA F
rows.zh: 信息增益 / 互信息、卡方、相关系数、S2N、ANOVA F

text.en: In practice
text.zh: 实践中

items.en: **No method is universally better**: the variable types, data distributions and learners vary too much.
items.zh: **没有哪种方法普遍更好**：变量类型、数据分布、学习器差别太大。

items.en: **Watch the complexity:** a univariate method may serve better than a multivariate one you cannot afford to finish.
items.zh: **注意复杂度：**一个单变量方法，可能比一个你跑不完的多变量方法更实用。

items.en: **Feature selection is not always necessary** to get good performance; some models (regularised, tree ensembles) cope with many features.
items.zh: **特征选择并非总是必要：**有些模型（带正则的、树的集成）自己就能应付很多特征。

prompt.en: Which pair is a wrapper and which a filter?
prompt.zh: 下面哪一个是包装法，哪一个是过滤法？

label.en: Ranking genes by mutual information with the disease label (filter); trying gene sets and scoring each with a trained classifier (wrapper)
label.zh: 按与疾病标签的互信息给基因排序（过滤）；试基因集并用训练好的分类器给每个集打分（包装）

label.en: Both are wrappers, since both end in a classifier
label.zh: 两个都是包装法，因为最后都要用分类器

feedback.en: Whether a *classifier is used to score the features* decides it. A filter may feed its selected features to a classifier afterwards, but its ranking does not involve one.
feedback.zh: 关键是*有没有用分类器给特征打分*。过滤法选出的特征之后当然可以交给分类器，但它的排序过程不涉及分类器。

label.en: The first is a wrapper because it uses the label
label.zh: 第一个是包装法，因为它用到了标签

feedback.en: Both use the label (all supervised selection does). A filter scores a feature against the label with a statistic, not with a trained model.
feedback.zh: 两者都用标签（所有监督的选择都用）。过滤法用统计量比较特征与标签，不用训练好的模型。

explain.en: Filter: statistic, no classifier, cheap. Wrapper: classifier in the loop, expensive, sees interactions.
explain.zh: 过滤：用统计量，不用分类器，便宜。包装：循环里有分类器，贵，看得见交互。

title.zh: 要多少次循环？

prompt.en: Forward selection (wrapper), $d = 20$ features, run all the way until every feature has been added, one train-evaluate cycle per candidate. How many cycles?
prompt.zh: 前向选择（包装法），$d = 20$ 个特征，一直做到所有特征都加入，每个候选一次训练—评估循环。共多少次循环？

title.zh: 算一个互信息

prompt.en: Eight instances with a binary feature $X$ and label $Y$: when $X = 1$ there are 4 instances, 3 with $Y = 1$ and 1 with $Y = 0$; when $X = 0$ there are 4 instances, 1 with $Y = 1$ and 3 with $Y = 0$. Compute $I(Y; X)$ in bits, to three decimals. (Hint: $I = H(Y) - H(Y \mid X)$.)
prompt.zh: 八个实例，二值特征 $X$ 和标签 $Y$：$X = 1$ 有 4 个实例，其中 3 个 $Y = 1$、1 个 $Y = 0$；$X = 0$ 有 4 个实例，其中 1 个 $Y = 1$、3 个 $Y = 0$。求 $I(Y; X)$，以比特计，保留三位小数。（提示：$I = H(Y) - H(Y \mid X)$。）

explain.en: $H(Y) = 1$ (4 and 4). Given $X$, each group has probabilities $(3/4, 1/4)$, entropy $-\frac34\log_2\frac34 - \frac14\log_2\frac14 = 0.8113$. So $I = 1 - 0.8113 = 0.1887$ bits.

hints.en: Both groups have the same entropy, so $H(Y \mid X)$ equals that entropy.
hints.zh: 两组的熵相同，所以 $H(Y \mid X)$ 就等于这个熵。

title.en: Two features that only work together
title.zh: 只有合起来才有用的两个特征

prompt.en: Features $A$ and $B$ each have mutual information 0 with the label, but together they determine it (like XOR). Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh: 特征 $A$ 和 $B$ 各自与标签的互信息为 0，合起来却能决定标签（像 XOR）。下面哪句对？

label.en: A univariate filter will rank both low and discard them; a wrapper that evaluates the pair together can keep them
label.zh: 单变量过滤法会把两者排得很低并丢掉；把这一对放在一起评估的包装法可以保留它们

label.en: The pair has mutual information 0 as well, because MI is additive over features
label.zh: 这一对的互信息也是 0，因为互信息对特征是可加的

feedback.en: MI is not additive. $I(Y; A, B) = H(Y) - H(Y \mid A, B)$, which is the full $H(Y)$ here.
feedback.zh: 互信息不可加。$I(Y; A, B) = H(Y) - H(Y \mid A, B)$，这里等于整个 $H(Y)$。

label.en: Greedy forward selection will always find them, because it tries every feature at step 1
label.zh: 贪心前向选择总能找到它们，因为第 1 步试了每个特征

feedback.en: Each of them alone gives no gain at step 1, so forward selection prefers any feature with a little gain and may never try $\{A, B\}$.
feedback.zh: 每个单独加入都没有收益，所以第 1 步它偏爱任何有一点收益的特征，可能永远不会试 $\{A, B\}$。

label.en: A decision tree cannot use them, so they are useless for every model
label.zh: 决策树用不上它们，所以对任何模型都没用

feedback.en: A tree can split on $A$ then on $B$ and reproduce XOR perfectly; the usefulness depends on the model, which is why wrappers ask the model.
feedback.zh: 决策树先按 $A$ 分、再按 $B$ 分，可以完美复现 XOR；有用与否取决于模型，所以包装法要问模型。

explain.en: A filter scores one feature at a time and cannot see interactions; a search over subsets can.
explain.zh: 过滤法一次评一个特征，看不见交互；在子集上搜索的方法可以。

title.zh: 选哪一类？

prompt.en: You have 20 000 gene-expression features and 150 patients, and need a first shortlist of about 200 genes in minutes, before trying any model. Which family fits best?
prompt.zh: 你有 20000 个基因表达特征和 150 个病人，要在几分钟内、先不试任何模型，得到约 200 个基因的初筛名单。哪一类最合适？

label.en: A filter, e.g. rank by mutual information or ANOVA F-value and keep the top 200
label.zh: 过滤法，例如按互信息或 ANOVA F 值排序，取前 200

label.en: Exhaustive wrapper search over all subsets
label.zh: 对所有子集做穷举的包装法搜索

feedback.en: $2^{20000}$ subsets: impossible. Even greedy forward selection needs about $2 \times 10^8$ fits.
feedback.zh: $2^{20000}$ 个子集：不可能。就是贪心前向选择也要约 $2 \times 10^8$ 次拟合。

label.en: Backward elimination, because it removes irrelevant features first
label.zh: 后向消除，因为它先去掉无关特征

feedback.en: It starts with all 20 000 features and trains up to 20 000 models at the first step. Far too slow here.
feedback.zh: 它从全部 20000 个特征开始，第一步就要训练多达 20000 个模型。这里慢得不可接受。

label.en: No selection: with 150 patients, more features always help
label.zh: 不做选择：150 个病人，特征越多越好

feedback.en: With $d \gg n$ extra features mostly add noise and invite overfitting.
feedback.zh: $d \gg n$ 时，多余的特征大多只增加噪声、招来过拟合。

explain.en: Cost decides: with huge $d$, use a linear-time filter (or an embedded L1 model) first; wrappers are for small $d$ or a pre-shortlisted set.
explain.zh: 代价决定：$d$ 巨大时先用线性时间的过滤法（或嵌入的 L1 模型）；包装法留给小的 $d$ 或已经初筛过的集合。

title.zh: 过滤法与包装法（A 部分）

prompt.en: Compare filter and wrapper feature selection. Give one advantage and one disadvantage of each. (3-4 lines)
prompt.zh: 比较过滤法和包装法的特征选择，各给出一个优点和一个缺点。（3-4 行）

key_points.en: Filter: independent of the classifier, scores features with a statistic (e.g. MI)
key_points.zh: 过滤法：独立于分类器，用统计量（如互信息）打分

key_points.en: Filter advantage: cheap, linear in the number of features
key_points.zh: 过滤法优点：便宜，与特征数成线性

key_points.en: Filter disadvantage: ignores interactions / redundancy and the specific model
key_points.zh: 过滤法缺点：忽略交互和冗余，也不顾具体的模型

key_points.en: Wrapper: trains the classifier on candidate subsets and scores them on validation data / CV
key_points.zh: 包装法：在候选子集上训练分类器，用验证集 / 交叉验证打分

key_points.en: Wrapper advantage: tuned to the model, can find interacting features; disadvantage: expensive ($d(d+1)/2$ fits greedy, $2^d$ exhaustive), may overfit validation data
key_points.zh: 包装法优点：针对模型，能找到有交互的特征；缺点：昂贵（贪心 $d(d+1)/2$ 次拟合，穷举 $2^d$），可能过拟合验证集

model_answer.en: A filter ranks each feature by a statistic such as mutual information, independently of the classifier. It is cheap (linear in the number of features) but ignores feature interactions and the model that will be used. A wrapper trains the classifier on candidate feature subsets and scores them by validation performance or cross-validation. It is tuned to the model and can find interacting features, but it is expensive (d(d+1)/2 fits for greedy forward selection, 2^d for exhaustive search) and can overfit the validation set.
model_answer.zh: A filter ranks each feature by a statistic such as mutual information, independently of the classifier. It is cheap (linear in the number of features) but ignores feature interactions and the model that will be used. A wrapper trains the classifier on candidate feature subsets and scores them by validation performance or cross-validation. It is tuned to the model and can find interacting features, but it is expensive (d(d+1)/2 fits for greedy forward selection, 2^d for exhaustive search) and can overfit the validation set.

explain.en: Section A wants the contrast in one breath: what it uses (statistic vs classifier), then its cost and its blind spot.
explain.zh: A 部分要你一口气说出对比：各自用什么（统计量还是分类器），然后是代价和盲点。

title.zh: 设计题：5000 个特征，200 个样本（C 部分）

prompt.en: A hospital wants to predict a disease from 5 000 gene-expression measurements of 200 patients, and a doctor wants a short, explainable list of genes. Design a feature-selection and evaluation pipeline and justify each choice. (A third of a page)
prompt.zh: 一家医院要用 200 个病人的 5000 个基因表达测量来预测某种疾病，医生想要一份简短、可解释的基因清单。设计一条特征选择加评估的流程，并说明每个选择的理由。（约三分之一页）

key_points.en: Cheap filter first (MI / ANOVA F / correlation) to cut 5000 to a few hundred
key_points.zh: 先用便宜的过滤法（互信息 / ANOVA F / 相关）把 5000 缩到几百

key_points.en: Then an embedded L1 (LASSO) model or RFE, giving a sparse, readable gene list; wrapper too costly at this d
key_points.zh: 再用嵌入的 L1（LASSO）模型或 RFE，得到稀疏、可读的基因清单；这个 d 下包装法太贵

key_points.en: Do the selection inside each cross-validation training fold (otherwise leakage makes the estimate optimistic); keep a final test set untouched
key_points.zh: 选择要在每个交叉验证的训练折内部做（否则泄漏使估计偏乐观）；保留一个最终测试集不动

key_points.en: Choose the number of features k and the penalty by cross-validation; use stratified folds for imbalance
key_points.zh: 用交叉验证选特征数 k 和惩罚系数；类别不平衡用分层折

key_points.en: Check stability and interpretability: repeated selection should give similar genes; correlated genes may be interchangeable
key_points.zh: 检查稳定性和可解释性：重复选择应得到相似的基因；相关的基因可能可互换

model_answer.en: (1) Filter: rank the 5000 genes by mutual information (or ANOVA F-value) with the label and keep a few hundred; this is linear in the number of features and fast. (2) Embedded: fit an L1-regularised logistic regression (LASSO) or SVM-RFE on those, which drives most weights to exactly zero and gives a short, readable gene list; a wrapper is too expensive at this d. (3) All selection and the choice of the number of features and of the penalty happen inside each training fold of cross-validation, with a separate test set kept untouched, otherwise leakage makes the accuracy look better than it is. (4) Use stratified folds if the classes are imbalanced, and check that repeated runs select similar genes, since correlated genes can substitute for each other.
model_answer.zh: A filter-then-embedded pipeline: (1) Filter: rank the 5000 genes by mutual information (or ANOVA F-value) with the label and keep a few hundred; linear in the number of features and fast. (2) Embedded: fit an L1-regularised logistic regression (LASSO) or SVM-RFE on those, which drives most weights to exactly zero and gives a short, readable gene list; a wrapper is too expensive at this d. (3) All selection, and the choice of the number of features and the penalty, happen inside each training fold of cross-validation, with a separate test set kept untouched, otherwise leakage makes the accuracy look better than it is. (4) Use stratified folds if the classes are imbalanced, and check that repeated runs select similar genes, since correlated genes can substitute for each other.

explain.en: Section C rewards a pipeline with reasons: cost (filter first), interpretability (L1), and honest evaluation (selection inside the folds).
explain.zh: C 部分看重有理由的流程：代价（先过滤）、可解释（L1）、评估诚实（选择放在折内）。

title.zh: 要记住的

rows.en: score each feature (MI, $\chi^2$, S2N, F, correlation), keep top $k$
rows.zh: 给每个特征打分（MI、$\chi^2$、S2N、F、相关），保留前 $k$

rows.en: search subsets, score each by the trained classifier (CV)
rows.zh: 在子集上搜索，用训练好的分类器（交叉验证）给每个打分

rows.en: slow; greedy can be sub-optimal; overfits validation
rows.zh: 慢；贪心可能次优；过拟合验证集

rows.en: selection inside training (RFE with $\theta_j^2$; L1 penalty)
rows.zh: 选择在训练内部完成（用 $\theta_j^2$ 的 RFE；L1 惩罚）

items.en: MI $= 0$ iff independent; MI = information gain; empirical MI favours many-valued features.
items.zh: 互信息 $= 0$ 当且仅当独立；互信息 = 信息增益；经验互信息偏爱取值多的特征。

items.en: Forward / backward selection: $d + (d-1) + \dots + 1 = d(d+1)/2$ cycles; all subsets: $2^d$ (the lattice).
items.zh: 前向 / 后向选择：$d + (d-1) + \dots + 1 = d(d+1)/2$ 次循环；所有子集：$2^d$（格）。

items.en: Forward is best when the optimal subset is small, backward when it is large; both are greedy and can be sub-optimal.
items.zh: 前向在最优子集小时最好，后向在最优子集大时最好；两者都是贪心，可能次优。

items.en: L0 counts non-zero weights (not convex, $2^d$ hard); L1 $\sum|\theta_j|$ is convex and gives exact zeros; L2 only shrinks.
items.zh: L0 数非零权重（非凸，$2^d$ 难）；L1 $\sum|\theta_j|$ 是凸的并给出恰好的零；L2 只收缩。

items.en: Do selection inside each cross-validation fold; no method is universally best; selection is not always needed.
items.zh: 选择要在每个交叉验证折内部做；没有普遍最好的方法；并非总是需要特征选择。
